clips.text: Douala, Cameroon. Madame Ngo runs two pharmacies… and she is tired of waiting.
Then she finds Akuma Pharma. Working with them takes four steps.
Step one… she sends her product list on WhatsApp.
Step two… the team in India sources it from W-H-O G-M-P certified manufacturers.
Step three… she receives a quote, with the manufacturer's documents to check.
Step four… she confirms, and the team follows her order all the way to her door.
Four steps. One team. No more waiting.
Your turn. Send us your product list on WhatsApp today.
Akuma Pharma… closer than you think.
